name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food Truck Ordering & Kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, protect your kitchen from over-ordering and keep serving when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service from.

Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark it ready and picked up.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T HIT
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a pickup time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add walk-up orders on the same screen as orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to make now, what's next and what's ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, ordering ahead pauses so nobody places an order you won't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync when you're back online.

BUILT FOR THE TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen awake during service, get notified when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
